company_name: Anhui Zhongke Xinyuan Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in thermoelectric temperature control systems specifically for semiconductor applications.
summary: Anhui Zhongke Xinyuan Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. (ZKMA) develops advanced thermoelectric temperature control systems tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their high-power semiconductor direct cooling units are designed for precision temperature management in various applications, serving notable semiconductor manufacturers globally.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and has established itself as a leader in high-power semiconductor refrigeration applications.
